assessment.caveat: None on cost; pure Markdown skills.

assessment.security: TypeScript monorepo with husky git hooks in the repo (dev only). Read-only source review; nothing installed.

assessment.caveat: The coding agent itself calls model APIs (user-supplied keys).

carried_forward.reason: manual read-only assessment (not a tested review): Read-only tree check: packages/durable and packages/telemetry are candidates for Wheel retry/dedup and live status; needs a source read and one isolated test.

assessment.license: NONE (no license file detected by GitHub)
assessment.security: Curated list plus skill folders; several (connect-apps, composio-skills) route through Composio's hosted service and need its account/API key.
assessment.compatibility: Ideas only: no license means no code reuse. Several skills appear to be copies of anthropics/skills, which should be used from the source instead.

carried_forward.name: OpenHands
carried_forward.note: Named by HQ one-tower-tycoon#1 comment 6283954094. MODEL-COST CAVEAT: OpenHands is an LLM coding agent; every run spends model API tokens (bring-your-own key) unless pointed at a local model.

reusable_modules: src/ (React agent UI: conversation and status views)
assessment.security: Runs agents in Docker sandboxes; .env.sample expects LLM keys. Not to be run here: Docker is not installed and paid model calls are out of scope.
assessment.compatibility: Useful as a reference for live agent status UI (Dashboard V2) and for mock-LLM testing of Wheel; adopting the runtime would add model cost.
assessment.caveat: Model API cost on every task; no free path without a local model.

carried_forward.reason: manual read-only assessment (not a tested review): Reject as a runtime: every task spends model API tokens (bring-your-own key) and it needs Docker. Keep as a reference for the mock-LLM Playwright test pattern and the agent status UI.
